text:
alexa: Proposing go/no-go for release 3.3 cut on Wed Apr 14 16:00 UTC. Goal: final canary, smoke, and a short RFC review for the infra storage change. Please RSVP with ✅/❌ by EOD Mon. Poll: https://poll.company/3.3-cut (or react).

sam: On-call clash for me at 16:00 UTC (pager). Can we shift to 18:00 UTC? That would push into APAC night though. :thinking:

li: 18:00 UTC would be rough for EU infra leads. Suggest 15:00 UTC — earlier for NA but better coverage overall. Can we do 15:00 UTC primary, 18:00 UTC fallback? :shrug:

maria: If we pick 15:00 primary, please add a 10m RFC review slot for the storage change and 10m for the rollback runbook. I'll assign owners. Also need canary owners assigned: @jon to own canary smoke.

jon: I can own canary smoke and run the quick failure drill. Will need two people to shadow — @sam + @maria?

sam: I can shadow but might need someone else to cover pager. @tasha any chance you can cover pager during that window?

tasha: I can take pager for the 15:00 UTC window. :thumbsup:

alexa: OK consensus leaning to 15:00 UTC primary. I'll post final invite after owners confirm. Draft agenda below.

alexa: ```
- 15:00 - 15:05 quick rollcall (owners + on-call)
- 15:05 - 15:15 RFC review: infra storage change (Maria)
- 15:15 - 15:25 Canary run + metrics check (Jon)
- 15:25 - 15:30 Rollback runbook + approvals
- 15:30 - 15:35 Final go/no-go decision
```

li: Add 5m at the start for 'blocking issues' — folks should add blockers to the doc beforehand. Link: https://docs.internal/3.3-cut (please add bullets under "blockers" section).

deploy-bot: NOTE: Scheduled smoke tests will start at 15:10 UTC automatically if canary flag is set. Run id: smoke-2177A.

alexa: Action items: maria assign RFC slides by Mon noon, jon prepare canary checklist, tasha cover pager. Please react with ✅ to confirm availability.

maria: Assigned slides, done.

jon: Checklist drafted and uploaded to the doc.

sam: ✅ (will try to be shadow but may need to pull pager if noisy)

tasha: ✅ I got pager cover.

alexa: Thanks — I'll send calendar invite with agenda + Zoom and attach the doc. If anyone absolutely cannot make 15:00 UTC, mark here and we'll consider the 18:00 fallback.

li: bumping for any late stakeholders — please don't change times without heads-up for product and security approvers.
